name: @pipeworx/mcp-art

tools.name: search_artworks
tools.description: Search the Met's collection by subject, artist or keyword (e.g., "sunflowers", "monet", "ancient egypt"). Artworks whose TITLE matches come first, then ones whose ARTIST or culture matches, then general full-text matches; each result says which via `matched_on`. Returns title, artist, date, medium and image URL.

tools.name: get_artwork
tools.description: Get full details for a specific artwork. Provide the object ID from search results. Returns title, artist, date, medium, department, and high-resolution image URL.

tools.name: get_departments
tools.description: Return the full list of Metropolitan Museum of Art curatorial departments (e.g., 'Egyptian Art', 'Modern and Contemporary Art'), each with its numeric department ID.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-art forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the art pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
